content.text: {"concept_key":"c9-physics-distance-vs-displacement","title":"Distance vs Displacement","quick":"Distance is the total path length covered, always positive. Displacement is the shortest straight line from start to end, with direction. Displacement can be zero even if distance isn't.","full":"Think of a child walking from home to the kirana shop and back. If home to shop is 200m, going and coming back means distance = 400m (path actually walked). But displacement = 0, because the child ends up exactly where they started - no net change in position. Distance only cares about 'how much ground was covered' (a number, scalar). Displacement cares about 'where you ended up compared to where you started' (a number with direction, vector). Distance is always greater than or equal to displacement, never less.","traps":["Writing displacement is always smaller than distance (not true if path is a straight line, they're equal)","Forgetting to mention direction when defining displacement","Saying displacement can be negative without explaining it just means opposite direction"],"misconception":"Many children think distance and displacement are just two names for the same thing, 'how far something moved'.","parent_questions":[{"q":"If you walk to the temple and back on the same road, what is your displacement?","expected_answer_hint":"Zero, because you return to the starting point, even though distance walked is not zero."},{"q":"Is displacement a scalar or a vector, and why?","expected_answer_hint":"Vector, because it has both magnitude and direction (a specific straight line from start to end)."}],"check_question":{"q":"Rahul walks 3 km east then 3 km west back to his starting point. What is his displacement?","options":["0 km","6 km east","3 km west"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Correct! He returns to the start, so net displacement is zero, though distance walked is 6 km.","wrong_feedback":"Not quite. Since he ends up exactly where he started, displacement is zero, even though he walked 6 km total."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A child walking along a straight village road from a house to a small shop and back, shown with footprints going and returning.","labels":[{"text":"home","position":"left"},{"text":"shop","position":"right"},{"text":"distance walked","position":"bottom"},{"text":"displacement = 0","position":"top"}]}}
